name: paranoidal-vehicle-physics
title: Paranoidal Vehicle Physics
author: OwnlyMe (Vehicle Physics, Shield FX), Zaflis (VehicleSnap); Paranoidal (merge and rewrite)
description: Paranoidal: one rewritten mod instead of Vehicle Physics 2.0.4, VehicleSnap 2.0.3 and Shield FX 2.0.1. Cars and tanks drift, leave tire marks and raise dust; the driving angle snaps to fixed angles (Shift+V); shields flash when they absorb damage. Script work runs only while someone drives or a shield effect is shown.
